name: QR Code Generator
description: Generates a QR code for the current page (rendered as a floating block) and provides admin tools to create page-specific QR overrides and ad-hoc QR codes from arbitrary text/URLs, using the chillerlan/php-qrcode library.
project_description:
Provides capability to generate dynamic QR Codes based on their current active page URL. 

 Features 
 
 Generate dynamic QR Codes using current page URL. 
 Share the QR code link directly over Email, Messages, and some social media platforms. 
 Admin screen is also available for content authors to generate QR code and download for custom URLs. 
 User can place the QR code block in several display format : QR will be shown as it is, QR as floating icons. 
 QR code for each individual can be downloaded for future references or any promotional uses. 
 
 Recommended modules/libraries 
 This project is strictly dependent of php chillerlan library ( https://github.com/chillerlan/php-qrcode ). In order to make this module functional make sure that chillerlan library is successfully downloaded and available in your site.
